answer.says: Ramesh, I have seen the file. It goes up for orders, and Mr. Saxena says to come back in fifteen days. The occupation is irregular. I must stand in the queue of the bureaucracy now, just as I stood in the lecture hall, but the content is my own house. Do you have the key to the kitchen? I am hungry, and the tea is strong, but the body requires more than spirit.
answer.thought: The administrative delay mirrors the dialectical suspension of the state; I am in the negative phase, waiting for the universal to recognize my particular claim. I have ₹96 left, which is precarious, but I must address the immediate physical need before the philosophical one. Ramesh is the only agent of action in this house, so I must direct him.
